gates.name: Requirements & PRD Gate
checks: PRD conforms to prd.schema.json
Functional requirements have testable acceptance criteria
Non-functional metrics defined (performance, security)
Out of scope explicitly demarcated
gates.pass_criteria: All functional items have acceptance criteria and user signoff artifact exists

gates.name: Architecture & TRD Gate
checks: TRD conforms to trd.schema.json
Traceability matrix maps 100% of PRD functional requirements to components
Threat model documented and approved by security-architect
Database schema and API contracts specified
gates.pass_criteria: Full traceability and architecture consistency signoff

gates.name: Code Quality & Unit Testing Gate
checks: Clean compilation/transpilation with zero fatal errors
Unit test pass rate is 100%
Code adheres to Clean Architecture and SOLID principles
No untested public interfaces
gates.pass_criteria: Clean build, 100% unit tests pass, code reviewer signoff

gates.name: Security & Vulnerability Gate
checks: Zero critical or high severity vulnerabilities in dependency audit
Static code analysis (SAST) shows no SQL injection, XSS, or path traversal
No hardcoded credentials, API keys, or private secrets
Authentication and authorization contracts strictly verified

gates.name: Release & Delivery Gate
checks: All previous gates passed with verified evidence
E2E test suite passes completely
Release documentation, changelog, and API docs are synchronized
Deliverable artifacts packaged and checksummed
gates.pass_criteria: All integration tests pass, documentation current, clean tag ready
